steps.en: Build the daemon in release configuration
steps.zh: 以 release 配置构建守护进程

steps.en: Install the binary and its system service
steps.zh: 安装二进制与系统服务

steps.en: Write the device configuration at the default path
steps.zh: 在默认路径写设备配置

steps.en: Declare the control id and the action it maps to
steps.zh: 声明控件 ID 与它映射的动作

steps.en: Reads the config once and discovers HID++ devices through hidraw
steps.zh: 读取一次配置，经 hidraw 发现 HID++ 设备

steps.en: Diverts matching button events and emits the configured keypress
steps.zh: 接管匹配的按键事件并发出配置的按键

value.en: Button, gesture, DPI and SmartShift mappings stay active through the logid background service
value.zh: 按键、手势、DPI 与 SmartShift 映射由 logid 后台服务持续生效

sources: README.md Building (mkdir build; cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release ..; make; sudo make install; sudo systemctl enable --now logid)
README.md Configuration (default config location /etc/logid.cfg, -c to override)
README.md Dependencies (C++20 compiler, cmake, libevdev, libudev, glib, libconfig)
logid.example.cfg (cid: 0xc3; action types Gestures/Keypress/CycleDPI/ToggleSmartshift; dpi, smartshift, hiresscroll blocks)
src/logid/Configuration.cpp (reads the config file once at startup)
src/logid/features/RemapButton.cpp and src/logid/InputDevice.cpp (button diversion and uinput event emission)
